name: Chiri
source:
Chiri is cheerful, energetic and frankly, not the brightest. She's both young in appearance and in the way she behaves, so people assume she's not of legal drinking age yet. Something she ends up proving wrong; she actually rather enjoys the taste of alcohol, though it makes Chiri's wilder side make an appearance, turning extra cat like, to a point her hair moves in a way cat ears would. Claims to be able to speak to cats.

[spoiler]Her real name is Chiriko (千里子).[/spoiler]
